output.letter:
At Sierra AI, I lead the development of a customer-support agent that leverages structured-output enforcement and targeted supervised fine-tuning on curated traces, increasing the verified-resolution rate from 41% to 67%. This hands-on experience building production tool-calling agents maps directly to Anthropic's need for engineering retrieval, tool-use, and eval stacks for customer-facing agents.

My role also includes designing a comprehensive eval harness with 14 task suites, deterministic replay, and detailed error taxonomies, now integrated into CI pipelines for every model update. This aligns with Anthropic's requirement for operationalizing continuous integration eval systems to maintain model quality. Moreover, I built a post-training data pipeline that mines failed agent traces and smartly routes them for human review, reducing rater throughput costs by over threefold. I am eager to bring this expertise in automated data curation and feedback loops to optimize Anthropic's agentic capabilities.

In addition to technical achievements, I have mentored engineers and led an internal research reading group, preparing me to support and grow a team of 3-5 ICs as envisioned for this role. With two first-author papers at EMNLP and NAACL on retrieval-augmented generation and system evaluation—evidenced by widely cited open-source toolkits—I understand recent RAG and agent literature deeply.

I look forward to contributing my applied LLM product development experience and leadership skills to Anthropic, while continuing to expand my knowledge in agent safety patterns and cutting-edge retrieval methods within your innovative environment.

Best,
Priya
